Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
v1.0.0: Pre-Prisma/Clerk Migration - Firebase/Firestore Implementation

## Summary
Initial version of Litplan iOS app with Firebase/Firestore backend.
This commit marks the state before migrating to Prisma + Clerk.

## Features Included
- iOS App \(SwiftUI, iOS 17+\)
  - Home/Explore view with city card stacks
  - Search view for city lookup
  - Viewed Cities tab
  - Profile view
  - Component library \(buttons, cards, states\)

- Backend \(Firebase Cloud Functions + TypeScript\)
  - Firestore data models \(User, City, Plan, GroupFlow\)
  - Authentication with Sign in with Apple
  - Subscription management with StoreKit 2
  - All API endpoints implemented
  - Weekly AI plan refresh scheduled function

- AI Team Workflow
  - Complete .ai-team coordination folder
  - Sprint plans and daily logs
  - QA reports and checklists

## Tech Stack
- Database: Cloud Firestore
- Auth: Sign in with Apple / iCloud
- Payments: StoreKit 2
- Backend: Firebase Cloud Functions
- iOS: SwiftUI, iOS 17+

## Next Version
v2.0.0 will migrate to:
- Database: Prisma + PostgreSQL / PlanetScale
- Auth: Clerk \(Google, Apple, Email/Password\)

EOF
